title: 威利斯大樓
summary: 威利斯大樓（原希爾斯大樓）由 Fazlur Khan 與 SOM 設計，九個 75 ft（22.9 m）見方的鋼框管組成 225 ft 見方的束筒，管筒在 50、66、90 層分批終止，只留兩管到頂。本課從束筒如何以內部框架減少剪力遲滯、分段收進如何降低質心與造成扭轉，到 15 ft 柱距框管、75 ft 複合樓板桁架、每週兩層的鋼構安裝與岩盤沉箱，再到週期量測、外牆熱隔離，以及 2017–2020 年在營運中改造底座時的柱補強與傳力路徑管理。
summaryEn: Willis Tower, formerly Sears Tower, designed by Fazlur Khan and SOM, bundles nine 75 ft (22.9 m) square steel framed tubes into a 225 ft square plan; the tubes stop in groups at floors 50, 66 and 90, leaving two to the top. The course covers how interior frames reduce shear lag, how staged terminations lower the mass centroid and create torsion, the 15 ft column module, 75 ft composite floor trusses, erection at two floors a week and rock caissons, then period measurement, thermal isolation by the skin, and column strengthening and load-path control during the 2017–2020 base repositioning of the occupied tower.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「束筒與剪力遲滯」與「管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bundled tubes and shear lag" and "Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 束筒與剪力遲滯：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bundled tubes and shear lag: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「九管束筒與內部腹板」如何影響威利斯大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs” governs force, deformation or durability in “Willis Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 框管結構把密排的周邊柱與深裙梁組成一個空心箱形懸臂，平行風向的兩面像箱梁腹板承受剪力，垂直風向的兩面像翼板承受拉壓。單一大管的翼板中段柱因裙梁剪力變形而「跟不上」角柱，軸力向角落集中，這就是剪力遲滯。束筒在 225 ft 見方的平面中多加兩道縱橫向內部框架，把翼板分成三段、腹板由兩道增為四道，使軸力分布更均勻，剪力勁度也加倍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「九管束筒與內部腹板」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A framed tube turns closely spaced perimeter columns and deep spandrels into a hollow box cantilever: the two faces parallel to the wind act like the webs of a box girder and carry shear, while the two faces normal to it act like flanges in tension and compression. In a single large tube the flange columns near mid-face lag behind the corners because the spandrels deform in shear, concentrating axial force at the corners; this is shear lag. The bundled tube adds two interior frames in each direction within the 225 ft square, splitting each flange into three segments and doubling the web frames from two to four, which evens out axial forces and doubles shear stiffness. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：懸臂剪力變形 Δ_s = wH²/(2nK)，n 為腹板框架數、K 為每道框架的等效剪力勁度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Cantilever shear deflection is Δ_s = wH²/(2nK), with n web frames each of equivalent shear stiffness K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「框管結構所有周邊柱都均勻分擔傾覆力矩產生的軸力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All perimeter columns of a framed tube share the overturning axial force equally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「九管束筒與內部腹板」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 束筒與剪力遲滯
knowledge.text: 框管結構把密排的周邊柱與深裙梁組成一個空心箱形懸臂，平行風向的兩面像箱梁腹板承受剪力，垂直風向的兩面像翼板承受拉壓。單一大管的翼板中段柱因裙梁剪力變形而「跟不上」角柱，軸力向角落集中，這就是剪力遲滯。
knowledge.textEn: A framed tube turns closely spaced perimeter columns and deep spandrels into a hollow box cantilever: the two faces parallel to the wind act like the webs of a box girder and carry shear, while the two faces normal to it act like flanges in tension and compression. In a single large tube the flange columns near mid-face lag behind the corners because the spandrels deform in shear, concentrating axial force at the corners; this is shear lag.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：框管結構所有周邊柱都均勻分擔傾覆力矩產生的軸力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All perimeter columns of a framed tube share the overturning axial force equally. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「威利斯大樓」的「束筒與剪力遲滯：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「高樓模型整合室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Bundled tubes and shear lag: mechanism and load path” in “Willis Tower”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Tower model integration room” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「束筒與剪力遲滯」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bundled tubes and shear lag" is correct?
options: 框管結構所有周邊柱都均勻分擔傾覆力矩產生的軸力。
框管結構把密排的周邊柱與深裙梁組成一個空心箱形懸臂，平行風向的兩面像箱梁腹板承受剪力，垂直風向的兩面像翼板承受拉壓。
收進只是為了造型與出租面積，對結構行為沒有影響。
optionsEn: All perimeter columns of a framed tube share the overturning axial force equally.

A framed tube turns closely spaced perimeter columns and deep spandrels into a hollow box cantilever: the two faces parallel to the wind act like the webs of a box girder and carry shear, while the two faces normal to it act like flanges in tension and compression.
Setbacks serve only appearance and leasing and do not affect structural behaviour.
quiz.explanation: 框管結構把密排的周邊柱與深裙梁組成一個空心箱形懸臂，平行風向的兩面像箱梁腹板承受剪力，垂直風向的兩面像翼板承受拉壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A framed tube turns closely spaced perimeter columns and deep spandrels into a hollow box cantilever: the two faces parallel to the wind act like the webs of a box girder and carry shear, while the two faces normal to it act like flanges in tension and compression. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 束筒與剪力遲滯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bundled tubes and shear lag: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「九管束筒與內部腹板」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：懸臂剪力變形 Δ_s = wH²/(2nK)，n 為腹板框架數、K 為每道框架的等效剪力勁度。取 w = 1.4 kPa×68.6 m ≈ 96.0 kN/m、H = 442 m、K = 1.0×10⁷ kN：n = 2 時 Δ_s = 96.0×442²/(2×2×10⁷) ≈ 0.469 m；n = 4 時 Δ_s ≈ 0.235 m，減半。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Cantilever shear deflection is Δ_s = wH²/(2nK), with n web frames each of equivalent shear stiffness K. With w = 1.4 kPa×68.6 m ≈ 96.0 kN/m, H = 442 m and K = 1.0×10⁷ kN, n = 2 gives Δ_s = 96.0×442²/(2×2×10⁷) ≈ 0.469 m and n = 4 gives Δ_s ≈ 0.235 m, half as much. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在三維框架模型中比較單一大管與九管束筒在同一風荷載下的翼板柱軸力分布，計算角柱與中段柱的軸力比作為剪力遲滯指標，並把剪力與彎曲兩部分的頂部變位拆開檢討。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In a three-dimensional frame model compare flange-column axial forces for one large tube and for the nine-tube bundle under the same wind load, use the ratio of corner to mid-face column force as a shear-lag index, and separate the shear and bending components of top drift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 懸臂剪力變形 Δ_s = wH²/(2nK)，n 為腹板框架數、K 為每道框架的等效剪力勁度。取 w = 1.4 kPa×68.6 m ≈ 96.0 kN/m、H = 442 m、K = 1.0×10⁷ kN：n = 2 時 Δ_s = 96.0×442²/(2×2×10⁷) ≈ 0.469 m；n = 4 時 Δ_s ≈ 0.235 m，減半。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Cantilever shear deflection is Δ_s = wH²/(2nK), with n web frames each of equivalent shear stiffness K. With w = 1.4 kPa×68.6 m ≈ 96.0 kN/m, H = 442 m and K = 1.0×10⁷ kN, n = 2 gives Δ_s = 96.0×442²/(2×2×10⁷) ≈ 0.469 m and n = 4 gives Δ_s ≈ 0.235 m, half as much. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「束筒與剪力遲滯」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bundled tubes and shear lag", which statement holds?
options: 樓板桁架只要強度足夠，剪力釘可以減量而不影響行為。
沉箱只要鑽到岩盤表面就能發揮全部承載力。
懸臂剪力變形 Δ_s = wH²/(2nK)，n 為腹板框架數、K 為每道框架的等效剪力勁度。
optionsEn: If the floor trusses are strong enough, shear studs can be reduced without affecting behaviour.
A caisson develops full capacity as soon as it touches the rock surface.
Cantilever shear deflection is Δ_s = wH²/(2nK), with n web frames each of equivalent shear stiffness K.
quiz.explanation: 懸臂剪力變形 Δ_s = wH²/(2nK)，n 為腹板框架數、K 為每道框架的等效剪力勁度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Cantilever shear deflection is Δ_s = wH²/(2nK), with n web frames each of equivalent shear stiffness K. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 束筒與剪力遲滯：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bundled tubes and shear lag: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「九管束筒與內部腹板」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在三維框架模型中比較單一大管與九管束筒在同一風荷載下的翼板柱軸力分布，計算角柱與中段柱的軸力比作為剪力遲滯指標，並把剪力與彎曲兩部分的頂部變位拆開檢討。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In a three-dimensional frame model compare flange-column axial forces for one large tube and for the nine-tube bundle under the same wind load, use the ratio of corner to mid-face column force as a shear-lag index, and separate the shear and bending components of top drift. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢核框管時要以完整三維模型而非平面等效梁取得角柱設計力，並把角柱、角隅接頭與內部框架交會柱列為加強檢驗的構件類別。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check framed tubes with a full three-dimensional model rather than an equivalent plane beam to obtain corner-column design forces, and place corner columns, corner joints and columns where interior frames intersect in an enhanced inspection category.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略剪力遲滯會低估角柱與其接頭的軸力，在強風下角柱或接頭可能先達到容量；同時高估中段柱的參與，使實際側向變位與樓板翹曲大於預期，帷幕牆接縫也被額外拉扯。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring shear lag underestimates axial forces in corner columns and their joints, which may reach capacity first in strong wind; it also overestimates the contribution of mid-face columns, so real drift and floor warping exceed predictions and façade joints are strained further. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在三維框架模型中比較單一大管與九管束筒在同一風荷載下的翼板柱軸力分布，計算角柱與中段柱的軸力比作為剪力遲滯指標，並把剪力與彎曲兩部分的頂部變位拆開檢討。
knowledge.textEn: In a three-dimensional frame model compare flange-column axial forces for one large tube and for the nine-tube bundle under the same wind load, use the ratio of corner to mid-face column force as a shear-lag index, and separate the shear and bending components of top drift.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 檢核框管時要以完整三維模型而非平面等效梁取得角柱設計力，並把角柱、角隅接頭與內部框架交會柱列為加強檢驗的構件類別。
knowledge.textEn: Check framed tubes with a full three-dimensional model rather than an equivalent plane beam to obtain corner-column design forces, and place corner columns, corner joints and columns where interior frames intersect in an enhanced inspection category.

quiz.question: 要驗證「束筒與剪力遲滯」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bundled tubes and shear lag"?
options: 在三維框架模型中比較單一大管與九管束筒在同一風荷載下的翼板柱軸力分布，計算角柱與中段柱的軸力比作為剪力遲滯指標，並把剪力與彎曲兩部分的頂部變位拆開檢討。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
帷幕牆只負責防水與外觀，與主結構的受力無關。
optionsEn: In a three-dimensional frame model compare flange-column axial forces for one large tube and for the nine-tube bundle under the same wind load, use the ratio of corner to mid-face column force as a shear-lag index, and separate the shear and bending components of top drift.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The curtain wall is only for weather-tightness and appearance and has nothing to do with structural forces.
quiz.explanation: 在三維框架模型中比較單一大管與九管束筒在同一風荷載下的翼板柱軸力分布，計算角柱與中段柱的軸力比作為剪力遲滯指標，並把剪力與彎曲兩部分的頂部變位拆開檢討。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In a three-dimensional frame model compare flange-column axial forces for one large tube and for the nine-tube bundle under the same wind load, use the ratio of corner to mid-face column force as a shear-lag index, and separate the shear and bending components of top drift. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 束筒與剪力遲滯：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bundled tubes and shear lag: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「九管束筒與內部腹板」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略剪力遲滯會低估角柱與其接頭的軸力，在強風下角柱或接頭可能先達到容量；同時高估中段柱的參與，使實際側向變位與樓板翹曲大於預期，帷幕牆接縫也被額外拉扯。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring shear lag underestimates axial forces in corner columns and their joints, which may reach capacity first in strong wind; it also overestimates the contribution of mid-face columns, so real drift and floor warping exceed predictions and façade joints are strained further. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：束筒在 225 ft 見方的平面中多加兩道縱橫向內部框架，把翼板分成三段、腹板由兩道增為四道，使軸力分布更均勻，剪力勁度也加倍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The bundled tube adds two interior frames in each direction within the 225 ft square, splitting each flange into three segments and doubling the web frames from two to four, which evens out axial forces and doubles shear stiffness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「框管結構所有周邊柱都均勻分擔傾覆力矩產生的軸力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All perimeter columns of a framed tube share the overturning axial force equally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略剪力遲滯會低估角柱與其接頭的軸力，在強風下角柱或接頭可能先達到容量；同時高估中段柱的參與，使實際側向變位與樓板翹曲大於預期，帷幕牆接縫也被額外拉扯。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring shear lag underestimates axial forces in corner columns and their joints, which may reach capacity first in strong wind; it also overestimates the contribution of mid-face columns, so real drift and floor warping exceed predictions and façade joints are strained further.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「束筒與剪力遲滯」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bundled tubes and shear lag" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
忽略剪力遲滯會低估角柱與其接頭的軸力，在強風下角柱或接頭可能先達到容量；同時高估中段柱的參與，使實際側向變位與樓板翹曲大於預期，帷幕牆接縫也被額外拉扯。
收進只是為了造型與出租面積，對結構行為沒有影響。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Ignoring shear lag underestimates axial forces in corner columns and their joints, which may reach capacity first in strong wind.
Setbacks serve only appearance and leasing and do not affect structural behaviour.
quiz.explanation: 忽略剪力遲滯會低估角柱與其接頭的軸力，在強風下角柱或接頭可能先達到容量；同時高估中段柱的參與，使實際側向變位與樓板翹曲大於預期，帷幕牆接縫也被額外拉扯。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring shear lag underestimates axial forces in corner columns and their joints, which may reach capacity first in strong wind; it also overestimates the contribution of mid-face columns, so real drift and floor warping exceed predictions and façade joints are strained further. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「50／66／90 層分段收進」如何影響威利斯大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Setbacks at floors 50, 66 and 90” governs force, deformation or durability in “Willis Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 九管全部升到 50 層，西北與東南兩管在此終止；東北與西南兩管在 66 層終止，形成十字形平面；北、東、南三管在 90 層終止，只剩西管與中央管到 108 層。逐段減少的樓板面積讓質量集中在下部，降低地震與風致慣性力的力臂，也讓不同高度的寬度變化擾亂渦流脫落。代價是 90 層以上只剩兩管，平面不再雙軸對稱，質心與剛心產生偏移，上部需要處理扭轉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「50／66／90 層分段收進」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: All nine tubes rise to floor 50, where the northwest and southeast tubes stop; the northeast and southwest tubes stop at floor 66, leaving a cruciform plan; the north, east and south tubes stop at floor 90, leaving only the west and centre tubes to floor 108. The shrinking floor area concentrates mass low down, shortening the lever arm of seismic and wind-induced inertia forces, and the width changes disrupt vortex shedding along the height. The price is that above floor 90 only two tubes remain, the plan loses double symmetry, the centres of mass and stiffness separate, and the upper levels must handle torsion. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Setbacks at floors 50, 66 and 90” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Count one unit per tube per floor with a 3.91 m storey: floors 1–50 give 450 units at a mid-height of 97.8 m, floors 51–66 give 112 at 226.8 m, floors 67–90 give 120 at 305.0 m and floors 91–108 give 36 at 387.1 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「收進只是為了造型與出租面積，對結構行為沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Setbacks serve only appearance and leasing and do not affect structural behaviour." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「50／66／90 層分段收進」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Setbacks at floors 50, 66 and 90”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉
knowledge.titleEn: Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion
knowledge.text: 九管全部升到 50 層，西北與東南兩管在此終止；東北與西南兩管在 66 層終止，形成十字形平面；北、東、南三管在 90 層終止，只剩西管與中央管到 108 層。逐段減少的樓板面積讓質量集中在下部，降低地震與風致慣性力的力臂，也讓不同高度的寬度變化擾亂渦流脫落。
knowledge.textEn: All nine tubes rise to floor 50, where the northwest and southeast tubes stop; the northeast and southwest tubes stop at floor 66, leaving a cruciform plan; the north, east and south tubes stop at floor 90, leaving only the west and centre tubes to floor 108. The shrinking floor area concentrates mass low down, shortening the lever arm of seismic and wind-induced inertia forces, and the width changes disrupt vortex shedding along the height.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：收進只是為了造型與出租面積，對結構行為沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Setbacks serve only appearance and leasing and do not affect structural behaviour. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion" is correct?
options: 收進只是為了造型與出租面積，對結構行為沒有影響。
框管的側向勁度主要由柱子決定，裙梁大小影響不大。
九管全部升到 50 層，西北與東南兩管在此終止；東北與西南兩管在 66 層終止，形成十字形平面；北、東、南三管在 90 層終止，只剩西管與中央管到 108 層。
optionsEn: Setbacks serve only appearance and leasing and do not affect structural behaviour.
A framed tube's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the columns; spandrel size hardly matters.
All nine tubes rise to floor 50, where the northwest and southeast tubes stop.
quiz.explanation: 九管全部升到 50 層，西北與東南兩管在此終止；東北與西南兩管在 66 層終止，形成十字形平面；北、東、南三管在 90 層終止，只剩西管與中央管到 108 層。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: All nine tubes rise to floor 50, where the northwest and southeast tubes stop; the northeast and southwest tubes stop at floor 66, leaving a cruciform plan; the north, east and south tubes stop at floor 90, leaving only the west and centre tubes to floor 108. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「50／66／90 層分段收進」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Setbacks at floors 50, 66 and 90” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以每管每層為一單位，層高 3.91 m：1–50 層 450 單位，中點 97.8 m；51–66 層 112 單位，226.8 m；67–90 層 120 單位，305.0 m；91–108 層 36 單位，387.1 m。質心高度 z = (450×97.8 + 112×226.8 + 120×305.0 + 36×387.1)/718 ≈ 167 m；若九管都到 108 層，z = 211 m，收進使質心降低約 21%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Count one unit per tube per floor with a 3.91 m storey: floors 1–50 give 450 units at a mid-height of 97.8 m, floors 51–66 give 112 at 226.8 m, floors 67–90 give 120 at 305.0 m and floors 91–108 give 36 at 387.1 m. The centroid height z = (450×97.8 + 112×226.8 + 120×305.0 + 36×387.1)/718 ≈ 167 m; with all nine tubes to floor 108, z = 211 m, so the setbacks lower the centroid by about 21%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從模型取出各樓層質心與剛心位置，檢查 90 層以上的偏心距與扭轉振態的頻率與參與質量；風洞試驗則需量測扭矩頻譜，確認上部扭轉造成的角落加速度在居住性準則內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Extract the centres of mass and stiffness at each floor from the model, checking the eccentricity above floor 90 and the frequency and participating mass of torsional modes; the wind-tunnel test must measure torque spectra to confirm that corner accelerations from upper-level torsion meet habitability criteria.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Count one unit per tube per floor with a 3.91 m storey: floors 1–50 give 450 units at a mid-height of 97.8 m, floors 51–66 give 112 at 226.8 m, floors 67–90 give 120 at 305.0 m and floors 91–108 give 36 at 387.1 m. The centroid height z = (450×97.8 + 112×226.8 + 120×305.0 + 36×387.1)/718 ≈ 167 m; with all nine tubes to floor 108, z = 211 m, so the setbacks lower the centroid by about 21%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion", which statement holds?
options: 以每管每層為一單位，層高 3.91 m：1–50 層 450 單位，中點 97.8 m。
鋼構安裝速度只取決於塔吊數量與工人數量。
規範的近似週期公式可以準確預測超高層的實際振動週期。
optionsEn: Count one unit per tube per floor with a 3.91 m storey: floors 1–50 give 450 units at a mid-height of 97.8 m, floors 51–66 give 112 at 226.8 m, floors 67–90 give 120 at 305.0 m and floors 91–108 give 36 at 387.1 m.
Steel erection speed depends only on the number of cranes and workers.

quiz.explanationEn: Count one unit per tube per floor with a 3.91 m storey: floors 1–50 give 450 units at a mid-height of 97.8 m, floors 51–66 give 112 at 226.8 m, floors 67–90 give 120 at 305.0 m and floors 91–108 give 36 at 387.1 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「50／66／90 層分段收進」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Setbacks at floors 50, 66 and 90” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從模型取出各樓層質心與剛心位置，檢查 90 層以上的偏心距與扭轉振態的頻率與參與質量；風洞試驗則需量測扭矩頻譜，確認上部扭轉造成的角落加速度在居住性準則內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Extract the centres of mass and stiffness at each floor from the model, checking the eccentricity above floor 90 and the frequency and participating mass of torsional modes; the wind-tunnel test must measure torque spectra to confirm that corner accelerations from upper-level torsion meet habitability criteria. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：收進樓層應列為結構檢核重點：樓板厚度與配筋、帶狀桁架或深梁的剪力傳遞、終止柱的錨定細部，並要求風洞報告分別列出順風、橫風與扭轉反應。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Treat setback floors as key structural checkpoints for slab thickness and reinforcement, shear transfer through belt trusses or deep beams and anchorage of terminating columns, and require the wind-tunnel report to list along-wind, across-wind and torsional responses separately.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若收進處的樓板與帶狀構件沒有足夠的剪力傳遞能力，終止管筒的柱力無法順利交給相鄰管筒，造成局部應力集中；上部扭轉若被低估，角落辦公室會感受到明顯旋轉擺動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If floors and belt members at a setback cannot transfer enough shear, forces from terminating tubes cannot pass smoothly to neighbouring tubes and stresses concentrate locally; if upper-level torsion is underestimated, corner offices feel noticeable twisting motion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從模型取出各樓層質心與剛心位置，檢查 90 層以上的偏心距與扭轉振態的頻率與參與質量；風洞試驗則需量測扭矩頻譜，確認上部扭轉造成的角落加速度在居住性準則內。
knowledge.textEn: Extract the centres of mass and stiffness at each floor from the model, checking the eccentricity above floor 90 and the frequency and participating mass of torsional modes; the wind-tunnel test must measure torque spectra to confirm that corner accelerations from upper-level torsion meet habitability criteria.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 收進樓層應列為結構檢核重點：樓板厚度與配筋、帶狀桁架或深梁的剪力傳遞、終止柱的錨定細部，並要求風洞報告分別列出順風、橫風與扭轉反應。
knowledge.textEn: Treat setback floors as key structural checkpoints for slab thickness and reinforcement, shear transfer through belt trusses or deep beams and anchorage of terminating columns, and require the wind-tunnel report to list along-wind, across-wind and torsional responses separately.

quiz.question: 要驗證「管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
從模型取出各樓層質心與剛心位置，檢查 90 層以上的偏心距與扭轉振態的頻率與參與質量；風洞試驗則需量測扭矩頻譜，確認上部扭轉造成的角落加速度在居住性準則內。
在承載中的鋼柱上焊接補強是沒有風險的例行作業。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Extract the centres of mass and stiffness at each floor from the model, checking the eccentricity above floor 90 and the frequency and participating mass of torsional modes.
Welding reinforcement onto a loaded steel column is a routine task with no risk.
quiz.explanation: 從模型取出各樓層質心與剛心位置，檢查 90 層以上的偏心距與扭轉振態的頻率與參與質量；風洞試驗則需量測扭矩頻譜，確認上部扭轉造成的角落加速度在居住性準則內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Extract the centres of mass and stiffness at each floor from the model, checking the eccentricity above floor 90 and the frequency and participating mass of torsional modes; the wind-tunnel test must measure torque spectra to confirm that corner accelerations from upper-level torsion meet habitability criteria. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「50／66／90 層分段收進」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Setbacks at floors 50, 66 and 90” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若收進處的樓板與帶狀構件沒有足夠的剪力傳遞能力，終止管筒的柱力無法順利交給相鄰管筒，造成局部應力集中；上部扭轉若被低估，角落辦公室會感受到明顯旋轉擺動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If floors and belt members at a setback cannot transfer enough shear, forces from terminating tubes cannot pass smoothly to neighbouring tubes and stresses concentrate locally; if upper-level torsion is underestimated, corner offices feel noticeable twisting motion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：代價是 90 層以上只剩兩管，平面不再雙軸對稱，質心與剛心產生偏移，上部需要處理扭轉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The price is that above floor 90 only two tubes remain, the plan loses double symmetry, the centres of mass and stiffness separate, and the upper levels must handle torsion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「收進只是為了造型與出租面積，對結構行為沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Setbacks serve only appearance and leasing and do not affect structural behaviour." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若收進處的樓板與帶狀構件沒有足夠的剪力傳遞能力，終止管筒的柱力無法順利交給相鄰管筒，造成局部應力集中；上部扭轉若被低估，角落辦公室會感受到明顯旋轉擺動。
knowledge.textEn: If floors and belt members at a setback cannot transfer enough shear, forces from terminating tubes cannot pass smoothly to neighbouring tubes and stresses concentrate locally; if upper-level torsion is underestimated, corner offices feel noticeable twisting motion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
框管的側向勁度主要由柱子決定，裙梁大小影響不大。
若收進處的樓板與帶狀構件沒有足夠的剪力傳遞能力，終止管筒的柱力無法順利交給相鄰管筒，造成局部應力集中；上部扭轉若被低估，角落辦公室會感受到明顯旋轉擺動。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A framed tube's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the columns; spandrel size hardly matters.
If floors and belt members at a setback cannot transfer enough shear, forces from terminating tubes cannot pass smoothly to neighbouring tubes and stresses concentrate locally.
quiz.explanation: 若收進處的樓板與帶狀構件沒有足夠的剪力傳遞能力，終止管筒的柱力無法順利交給相鄰管筒，造成局部應力集中；上部扭轉若被低估，角落辦公室會感受到明顯旋轉擺動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If floors and belt members at a setback cannot transfer enough shear, forces from terminating tubes cannot pass smoothly to neighbouring tubes and stresses concentrate locally; if upper-level torsion is underestimated, corner offices feel noticeable twisting motion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
